mapper.select: SELECT id job_id,status job_status,next_start,page_size,records_total,rows_seen,rows_inserted, attempt_count,last_error,started_time,completed_time FROM genbase_collection_job WHERE status IN ('STOPPED','FAILED') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE genbase_collection_job SET status='RUNNING',page_size=#{pageSize},attempt_count=0,last_error=NULL, started_time=COALESCE(started_time,NOW()),completed_time=NULL,update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{jobId} AND status IN ('STOPPED','FAILED')

mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO genbase_publication( paper_id,pmid,doi,bioproject_accession,journal_name,paper_title,publish_year, genbase_accessions,source_url,raw_payload,openlb_status,source_hash,fetched_at,create_time,update_time ) VALUES
(#{row.paperId},#{row.pmid},#{row.doi},#{row.bioprojectAccession},#{row.journalName}, #{row.paperTitle},#{row.publishYear},#{row.genbaseAccessions},#{row.sourceUrl},CAST(#{row.rawPayload} AS JSON), 'PENDING',#{row.sourceHash},NOW(),NOW(),NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_primary=1,paper_id=COALESCE(paper_id,VALUES(paper_id)), openlb_status=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)), 'PENDING',openlb_status), openlb_attempt_count=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),0,openlb_attempt_count), openlb_last_error=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),NULL,openlb_last_error), openlb_last_attempt_time=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),NULL,openlb_last_attempt_time), openlb_completed_time=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),NULL,openlb_completed_time), relation_status=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),'PENDING',relation_status), pmid=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),COALESCE(VALUES(pmid),pmid),pmid), doi=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),COALESCE(VALUES(doi),doi),doi), bioproject_accession=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(bioproject_accession),bioproject_accession), journal_name=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(journal_name),journal_name), paper_title=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(paper_title),paper_title), publish_year=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(publish_year),publish_year), genbase_accessions=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(genbase_accessions),genbase_accessions), raw_payload=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(raw_payload),raw_payload), source_hash=VALUES(source_hash)
mapper.update: UPDATE genbase_collection_job SET next_start=#{nextStart},records_total=#{recordsTotal},rows_seen=rows_seen+#{seen}, rows_inserted=rows_inserted+#{inserted},attempt_count=0,last_error=NULL,update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{jobId} AND status='RUNNING'

UPDATE genbase_publication SET openlb_status='PENDING',openlb_attempt_count=0,openlb_last_error=NULL, openlb_last_attempt_time=NULL,openlb_completed_time=NULL,update_time=NOW() WHERE paper_id IS NOT NULL AND is_primary=1
UPDATE genbase_publication SET openlb_status='RUNNING',openlb_last_attempt_time=NOW(),update_time=NOW() WHERE openlb_status='PENDING' AND paper_id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id,paper_id,pmid,doi,paper_title title,publish_year pub_year,journal_name journal_title,bioproject_accession,abstract_text,affiliation_info,keyword_list,authors_json,mesh_headings_json,grants_json,cncb_banks_json FROM genbase_publication WHERE paper_id IN #{id} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE genbase_publication SET relation_status=CASE paper_id WHEN #{r.paperId} THEN CASE WHEN NOT(authors_json<=>#{r.authorsJson}) OR NOT(affiliation_info<=>#{r.affiliationInfo}) OR NOT(grants_json<=>#{r.grantsJson}) OR NOT(cncb_banks_json<=>#{r.cncbBanksJson}) OR NOT(keyword_list<=>#{r.keywordList}) OR NOT(mesh_headings_json<=>#{r.meshHeadingsJson}) THEN 'PENDING' ELSE relation_status END ELSE relation_status END, abstract_text=CASE paper_id WHEN #{r.paperId} THEN #{r.abstractText} ELSE abstract_text END, affiliation_info=CASE paper_id WHEN #{r.paperId} THEN #{r.affiliationInfo} ELSE affiliation_info END, keyword_list=CASE paper_id WHEN #{r.paperId} THEN #{r.keywordList} ELSE keyword_list END, authors_json=CASE paper_id WHEN #{r.paperId} THEN #{r.authorsJson} ELSE authors_json END, mesh_headings_json=CASE paper_id WHEN #{r.paperId} THEN #{r.meshHeadingsJson} ELSE mesh_headings_json END, grants_json=CASE paper_id WHEN #{r.paperId} THEN #{r.grantsJson} ELSE grants_json END, cncb_banks_json=CASE paper_id WHEN #{r.paperId} THEN #{r.cncbBanksJson} ELSE cncb_banks_json END, openlb_raw_payload=CASE paper_id WHEN #{r.paperId} THEN #{r.rawPayload} ELSE openlb_raw_payload END, openlb_status=CASE paper_id WHEN #{r.paperId} THEN #{r.status} ELSE openlb_status END,openlb_attempt_count=openlb_attempt_count+1,openlb_last_error=NULL, openlb_completed_time=NOW(),update_time=NOW() WHERE paper_id IN #{r.paperId}
UPDATE genbase_publication SET openlb_status='EMPTY',openlb_attempt_count=openlb_attempt_count+1,openlb_last_error=NULL, openlb_completed_time=NOW(),update_time=NOW() WHERE paper_id IN #{id}

UPDATE genbase_publication SET openlb_status=CASE WHEN openlb_attempt_count+1>=#{maxAttempts} THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, openlb_attempt_count=openlb_attempt_count+1, openlb_last_error=CASE paper_id WHEN #{r.paperId} THEN #{r.error} ELSE openlb_last_error END, update_time=NOW() WHERE paper_id IN #{r.paperId}
